content.overview: Board meetings follow ss 173-175. General meetings follow ss 96-122.
content.glance: Board meetings follow ss 173-175. General meetings follow ss 96-122.
content.study: An annual general meeting is required within six months of the financial year end, and not later than fifteen months from the previous meeting, with the first AGM within nine months. Quorum is s. 103. Ordinary and special resolutions are defined in s. 114. Notice is s. 101, and explanatory statement for special business is s. 102. Poll, proxies and voting are ss 105-109.

caseLaw.name: Foss v Harbottle
caseLaw.point: Internal irregularities are for the company in general meeting to ratify, subject to the limits in the Act. The rule does not bar an oppression petition or a class action.
